blocks.raw: Configuration flags and prerequisites required to enable User Group Loyalty.
blocks.text: Configuration flags and prerequisites required to enable User Group Loyalty.

blocks.raw: To implement User Group Loyalty, ensure the following configurations are completed. All organizational flags listed below require a JIRA ticket submitted to the Capillary Product Support Team to be enabled.
blocks.text: To implement User Group Loyalty, ensure the following configurations are completed. All organizational flags listed below require a JIRA ticket submitted to the Capillary Product Support Team to be enabled.

blocks.raw: Before enabling group-specific features, a loyalty program must be active and incentives such as the tiers, points issual and expiry rules must be defined. This program can be used for both individuals and user groups.
blocks.text: Before enabling group-specific features, a loyalty program must be active and incentives such as the tiers, points issual and expiry rules must be defined. This program can be used for both individuals and user groups.

blocks.raw: # 2. Enable the mandatory user group flags
blocks.text: 2. Enable the mandatory user group flags

blocks.raw: These flags are required to enable user groups for your organization:
blocks.text: These flags are required to enable user groups for your organization:

blocks.raw:
* `CONF_USER_GROUP_ENABLED`: Must be set to `true` to enable any user group functionality.
* `CONF_USER_GROUP_SIZE`: Enables membership capping. Use this to restrict the maximum number of members per group (e.g., limiting a "Family Plan" to 5 members to prevent system abuse).

  Example: With a cap of 5, a group may consist of 1 primary member and 4 secondary members. Any attempt to add a 6th member will be automatically declined.

blocks.raw: # 3. Enable the mandatory fleet hierarchy flags
blocks.text: 3. Enable the mandatory fleet hierarchy flags

blocks.raw: These additional flags are required to enable fleet-based (business) user groups for your organization:
blocks.text: These additional flags are required to enable fleet-based (business) user groups for your organization:

blocks.raw:
* `IS_HEIRARCHY_STRICT`: Enforcement of exact role sequences. Skipping intermediate roles is prohibited.
* `IS_SKIP_ROLE_ALLOWED`: Bypasses intermediate roles, allowing direct assignment for example, Owner directly to Driver.
* `GROUP_CREATION_ENABLED`: Set to `true` to trigger automatic group creation whenever a user is assigned to a specific hierarchy role. This is recommended for fleet programs to streamline member association.

blocks.raw: # 4. Enable flags for OTP verification and security
blocks.text: 4. Enable flags for OTP verification and security

blocks.raw: Define the level of authentication required for group modifications. Choose one of the following flags based on your security requirements:
blocks.text: Define the level of authentication required for group modifications. Choose one of the following flags based on your security requirements:

blocks.raw:
* `CONF_USER_GROUP_OTP_ENABLE`: Mandates OTP verification for all join and leave actions for every member.
* `CONF_USER_GROUP_PRIMARY_USER_OTP_ENABLE`: Restricts OTP verification to administrative actions performed by the primary member, for example removing members or editing group settings.
